plan.why: Its Flask server is small, so llocal rewrites it in Go on llocal's kit. A Go server starts in a moment and needs little memory, so the app is quick and can sleep when nobody is using it.
found: An app with its own Flask server.
5 server routes, like GET /api/orders, POST /api/orders, GET /api/orders/{order_id} and 2 more.

left.text: Its Flask server (5 routes in 4 files, 1 KB) is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit.
It has no llocal.json yet: the short file that tells llocal how to build and start it.

changes.text: The Flask server is rewritten in Go on llocal's kit, answering at the same addresses.
